method: Ghidra decompilation and instruction listings of the identified executable. Name literals, StackOperator vftables, constants and the GetArguments_ literal were compared with the PE bytes through its section table. Addresses are virtual addresses.
scope: Static Lua call contracts for selected Control-class natives: declared argument and return StackOperator lists, owning native class, callback and forwarding target. Argument indices count internal ExecuteParameters cells. Source-level receiverless Global mapping remains unresolved. Client-side contracts do not establish server behavior.

framework.registration: Each registrar builds a return-type list and an argument-type list, then calls a per-class wrapper that constructs the 0x58-byte functor through a constructor such as 0x00724C10. The argument list is stored at functor +0x14 and the return list at +0x24. The MemberFunctionHolder vftable installed by the holder constructor names the owning native class. 0x00CCCAD0 installs the functor under the name built by 0x00447260.

typeRegistry.tagRule: The 16-byte ExecuteParameters value tag at +0x0C equals the builtin registry index.
typeRegistry.composite: Which<...> lists are WhichStackOperator instances (0x00CCA470) appended through 0x00CCA2D0.

argumentMarshalling.perArgument: 0x00CFAA10 dispatches a present position through the declared StackOperator's slot +4. The selected int, float, bool, Utf8String and LuaControl* readers advance the shared cursor once on normal return. Variable scans a recognized suffix as recorded by framework.variableArgumentReader. Other operators are not revalidated by that record.
argumentMarshalling.missingArguments: When the declared cursor exceeds the Lua top, 0x00CFAA10 constructs one tag-6 placeholder through 0x00583F70 and 0x00584EE0 without reading a present Lua value, then advances the formal cursor once.
argumentMarshalling.extraArguments: 0x00D19A20 compares the resulting shared cursor with its saved bound after all declared readers. Cursor greater than the bound bypasses the diagnostic. Otherwise it reaches 0x00CF3360 and 0x00CF38A0 with the GetArguments_ diagnostic. Declared list length alone does not determine this outcome for Variable.
argumentMarshalling.typedReaders: 0x005819A0 int tag 0, 0x0071BAC0 float tag 1, 0x0071BA00 bool tag 2, 0x0071CE70 string tag 3, 0x0071BEB0 LuaControl* tag 4. A mismatched tag reaches 0x00CCA730.

widgetCreationOnInit.scope: New-control creation with a WidgetBase receiver and successful named method lookup.

observations.observation: The creation callback passes index 3 to 0x00753B90. That helper copies 16-byte internal argument cells from source_begin + index * 0x10 through source_end, in order.
0x00791110 traverses the copied cells in increasing address order and dispatches on the tag at +0x0C.
WidgetBase vtable 0x00FD5A74 plus slot 0x6C is 0x00FD5AE0. The original-PE DWORD there, file offset 12409568, is 0x006E3920.

The converted container is stack argument 4 of a five-argument creation virtual call. The WidgetBase wrapper forwards it as 0x0078BBB0 argument 5 and supplies zero as argument 6. The latter function forwards argument 5 as 0x00CD0910 argument 3 with the control and the _onInit name at 0x00FE04F0.

Tag 6 reaches 0x00748EC0, which selects builtin entry 6, calls 0x0078DD00 and calls the catalog-named Nil pusher 0x00748920. That pusher calls 0x00583F70 before 0x00584EE0. This does not establish runtime Nil emission.

The invocation visits operator entries in increasing index order and passes the same zero-initialized local address to each callback. Callback 0x00CCFF60 adds the EAX result of 0x00CF9630 to context +0x14. The count begins at zero, then C + 1 is passed to 0x00CF4010 or 0x00CF4230.

supportedInferences.inference: Bounded forwarding-helper pseudocode connects the converted container to the named _onInit invocation during this conditional new-control path. No live scheduling behavior follows.

Successful lookup leaves callable then lookup-derived receiver before emitted payload values. The receiver is Lua argument 1 and emitted values begin at argument 2. This relies on thin-helper and ordinary negative-index-resolver pseudocode as well as observed replace-and-pop instructions.

variableArgumentReader.scope: GetArguments_ and the concrete Variable reader, with conditional _createActor native-frame positions. Receiverless script/global positions remain unresolved.
variableArgumentReader.identityLimits: Exact selected instructions and read-slot DWORDs were compared with the identified original PE. Entire loaded-image/FileBytes identity, pseudocode-only paths and live behavior remain unverified.

observations.observation: The shared cursor begins at 2. Declared readers receive its address. The final cursor must exceed the saved bound to bypass the GetArguments_ diagnostic calls.

Positive index i maps to [state+0x0C] + (i-1)*0x10 when below [state+8], otherwise sentinel 0x01133268. The bound leaf computes ([state+8]-[state+0x0C]) >> 4. Forwarding through the bound wrapper retains its pseudocode dependency.

The concrete reader initializes a local scan from the shared cursor, delegates reads through selected operators, increments the local scan and repeats through the saved bound. It does not itself increment the shared cursor.
The predicate tree recognizes raw tags 3, 4, 1, 5 and 0. Failure of the final predicate ends the scan before the current value is delegated.
Each of the six selected concrete readers increments its shared cursor by one on normal return.
When no current position exists, the dispatcher constructs tag 6, calls the append helper once and advances the formal cursor once, without invoking the actual reader.
The concrete selected Nil reader constructs a tag-6 cell, calls the append helper once and increments the shared cursor. Present raw tag 0 is not a scan terminator.
Registration calls 0x00CD7670, which forwards four arguments to 0x00D07820. These calls do not establish a receiverless script/global stack transformation.

variableArgumentReader.registryIdentityBoundary: Reader labels and positional registry identities use the existing published builtin order and matching named constructor blocks. EH-state numbers are not ordinal proof.

successfulReaderContract.derivation: Observed scan/delegation and all selected normal-return cursor increments.
conditions: The supplied native frame is valid.
Existing published registry identities identify the selected readers.
The bound forwarding helper has the behavior shown by the bounded thin-helper pseudocode.
All selected readers and supporting allocation/conversion/control helpers return normally.
successfulReaderContract.presentSuffix: For entry cursor p <= saved top T, a fully recognized successful suffix consumes T-p+1 present positions and returns cursor T+1. There is no fixed one-value limit in this reader.
successfulReaderContract.numericBranch: Raw tag 3 uses 0x00CF3670 to choose the catalog int or float reader. Numeric conversion range and exceptional values remain unresolved.
successfulReaderContract.controlBranch: Raw tag 5 selects the catalog LuaControl* reader, conditional on successful record resolution. This does not establish acceptance of arbitrary tables.
successfulReaderContract.unsupportedSuffix: The first unsupported tag remains unconsumed. With Variable last in the declared list, the final GetArguments_ bound comparison reaches its diagnostic path.
successfulReaderContract.omittedSuffix: The dispatcher fallback consumes no present Lua value, constructs one tag-6 placeholder through one append-helper call and advances the formal cursor once.
successfulReaderContract.internalAppendBoundary: Each successful selected path calls 0x00584EE0 once. Interpreting that call as one appended internal cell relies on the existing container append contract. Return emission to Lua is outside scope.

createActorNativeFrameMapping.condition: The published declared prefix is Utf8String, Utf8String, bool and these prefix readers complete successfully.

positions.meaning: Excluded by the initial cursor. Receiver/context and source-level mapping remain unresolved.

createActorNativeFrameMapping.presentCount: If T >= 5 and suffix readers return normally, T-4 present suffix values are consumed.
createActorNativeFrameMapping.omission: If T < 5, dispatcher fallback supplies the Variable placeholder without reading a present position.
createActorNativeFrameMapping.boundary: This is marshalling-only native-frame mapping, not source-level Global call arity or callback/actor success.

globalBinding.finiteGap: No inspected artifact establishes how a receiverless script/global call supplies or transforms native-frame position 1. The context-preparation call 0x00D04FE0 was not investigated.

Assigns the filename to the CutScene object's string at +0x6C through 0x00447450. No load is started by this callback.
Assigns the filename to the SpreadSheet string at +0x60, passes that string to virtual slot 1 of the object returned by 0x0075F5A0, and stores the result at +0xB4.

Calls 0x0075B750, which resolves the control through 0x004D9910 and calls 0x00537D50. ActorBaseClass returns true for any control. CharaBaseClass, PlayerBaseClass, NpcBaseClass, AreaBaseClass, DirectorBaseClass and DesktopWidget are tested with the RTTI cast 0x009DA6CC against the matching native class. Any other name is tested by 0x00CC7210 with the control and the name.

rows.behavior: The existing-control branch pushes the control at once when its initialization flag is set and otherwise yields. The creation branch calls virtual slot +0x6C at 0x00709A78 on the object from 0x00CC7A00, then yields. Both yields go through 0x00CD2860 with a Global::OnInitResumeChecker built by 0x00713FE0. Checker slot 0x007140C0 polls initialization. Slot 0x007493A0 pushes the control through 0x00748B30 on resume.

If argument 0 is Nil, passes the static value at 0x0130CF00 to 0x00CC7400. Otherwise scans arguments in order and stops at the first Nil. Each float f becomes the integer trunc(f * 10000.0 + 0.5) / 10 (constants 0x00FE0570 and 0x00F59898, signed division truncating toward zero), is wrapped by 0x00CD6AB0 and is passed to 0x00CC7400.
0x0078D520 converts the copied arguments through 0x00791030, invokes 0x00CD25F0 with the method name and pushes each result by its tag. The declared argument list holds one Variable after the name.
rows.conflict: docs/door-initialization-native-contract.md reads 0x0078D520 as preserving two trailing values for a three-argument call. The declared list admits one trailing value, and 0x00D19A20 raises GetArguments_ when Lua arguments remain. The two observations are unreconciled.

rows.behavior: Reads the focused identity through 0x0075BA10 with the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C. Identity -0x40000000 pushes Nil. Otherwise the identity is resolved through 0x00CC9320 and 0x00CC7A50. A missing control pushes Nil and a resolved control is pushed as LuaControl*.

boundaries: Global natives _isInstanceOf and _createActor are documented by ExecuteParameters position. The receiver binding that maps a global Lua call onto those positions was not traced.
